rapport_notes: Genuine, warm tone throughout; natural connection over shared plant-mom detail; authentic enthusiasm for the customer's confidence in repeat business.
process_discipline_notes: All three differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) were delivered together in a single Stage 2 block without being separated or anchored to the takeaway logic; this reads as a recap rather than a ramp-up earn.

evidence_quotes.agenda: And then first off, do you have any like, questions or concerns you want answered on the phone today in regards to the move?
evidence_quotes.agenda_context: Asked AFTER pulling up account and confirming participation — probing started before agenda was requested.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep asked about heavy furniture, fragile items (TVs), then followed up on TV size ('how large are those TVs?'); asked about couch and dining furniture as a single probe; customer volunteered furniture list without rep having to dig deeper on each item.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We do have that no worries, damage coverage. Which is the free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate provides up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: We do have that mecum, mover feature. A few days before your move you'll receive a meet your mover email introducing them to you helping ease attention that strangers arriving at your front door.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We do have our on time guarantee we value your time. So, if we can't make it in time window we arranged we mainly start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.estimate: It looks like the system quoted you at two and a half hours which is our minimum. But I always like to have a buffer like two and a half to three and a half hours so I'm gonna send you an updated email.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: Once we go over that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.close_missing: No rate-lock language; no explicit ask ('would you like our help with your move?'); call ends with 'if you have any questions please reach out' and 'I'm gonna send over this email.'

top_strength: Exceptional rapport and natural engagement—Brianne built immediate trust with a repeat customer, found genuine common ground (plant parent), and kept the customer comfortable throughout a smooth logistics review.
coaching_note: Stage 3 needs the full Save Your Ass framework: after quoting the estimate, anchor it ('A 650-to-900 sq ft move typically runs 2–3.5 hours; you're first-floor both ends, so I'd expect you mid-range'), then walk through the five lines (commit, window, beats it, self-prep, does-that-feel-fair pause), and close with rate-lock + explicit ask—you stopped after the email send and missed the close entirely.
